request.state: Fictional clause: Either party may end this agreement by giving the other party at least 30 days of written notice.

decision.instructions: Does the provided clause explicitly require at least 30 days of written notice to end the agreement? Check only the supplied words.

criteria.false: No: the clause does not explicitly state that requirement.
criteria.true: Yes: the clause explicitly states at least 30 days of written notice.

request.state: Fictional clause: This agreement lasts for one year. Any extension requires a new written agreement signed by both parties.

decision.instructions: Does the provided clause explicitly say the agreement renews automatically? Check only the supplied words.

criteria.false: No: automatic renewal is absent, or an extension requires a new signed agreement.
criteria.true: Yes: the agreement explicitly renews automatically without a new signed agreement.

request.state: Fictional work item: A draft vendor agreement is waiting for review. The team’s internal target is tomorrow. A reviewer must check the payment terms before the team can finish its review.

decision.instructions: Rate document-review priority using the supplied internal workflow levels. Use only the stated timing and work status; do not infer a legal deadline or legal risk.
criteria: Archived: review is complete and no action remains.
Low: review is needed but no internal target date is stated.
Routine: review is needed with an internal target more than a week away.
Soon: review is needed with an internal target in two to seven days.
First: review is still needed and the internal target is today or tomorrow.
